title: TimeResult
description:
`core.time` result: daemon receive (d1) and send (d2) monotonic times, so the client can remove
server processing time from the offset estimate (CR-UI-03).

recv_mono_ns.description: d1: daemon monotonic ns when the request was received.

send_mono_ns.description: d2: daemon monotonic ns when the reply was sent.

U64.description: Unsigned 64-bit integer as canonical decimal string (no sign, no leading zero).
